narrative.overview:
SUNNA is a single warm sheet of cream paper (the "lámina") lit by one orange sun. Everything visual comes from the SUNNA Web reference canvas (1440px); the PDF brief supplies the words. The page reads as a calm editorial poster: large regular-weight DM Sans headlines on cream, small uppercase tracked labels at card corners, soft peach cards with 28px corners, and two moments of weight where the sheet turns dark: the Tinta Recovery band and the Naranja 900 founders band. A fine film grain sits over the whole page so the cream never reads as flat screen white.

Depth comes from light rather than structure: radial orange halos (hero, FAQ, closing sun arc), frosted glass on the few floating surfaces (header pill, mobile bar, hero card, FAQ card, cursor), and warm-tinted shadows. Geometry comes from the circle and the arch: pill buttons, round glyph medallions, arch-topped "portal" photos, a sun arc rising behind the closing wordmark.

Content that the brief has not yet supplied is shown honestly, in a small monospace `[PENDIENTE]` marker, never faked.
keyCharacteristics: Cream ground (#fdf6ee) with a 3.5% multiply film grain over everything.
One orange voice (Naranja 500) for the CTA pill, sun halos, map pin, active arrows and badges.
Regular weight everywhere; size and tight tracking carry hierarchy, not boldness.
Uppercase 11px labels tracked +16% name places, groups, card titles and data.
Two dark bands (Tinta, Naranja 900) and one dark highlighted card (Premium) break the cream rhythm.
Glass only where something floats over imagery or light.
Arch portals, circle glyphs and a rising sun arc as the shape vocabulary.

rules.name: The Orange-Is-Not-Ink Rule
rules.body: Text is Tinta, Tinta 60, Crema (on dark) or Naranja 900. Naranja 500 and 700 never set text; text sitting on Naranja 500 is Tinta.

rules.name: The Two Dark Bands Rule
rules.body: Dark surfaces are deliberate and few: the Tinta Recovery band, the Naranja 900 founders band and footer, and the one highlighted membership card. Everything else stays on cream, tostado or peach.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Line Rule
rules.body: Emphasis and atmosphere come from radial orange light fading to cream, never from saturated flat blocks of Naranja 500 larger than a button or badge.

rules.name: The Regular Voice Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is size and tracking. Nothing is bold; 500 is reserved for small action or badge text.

rules.name: The Tight-Top Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens as size grows (−0.015em titles, −0.02em headlines, −0.025/−0.03em display and figures). Body text is never tracked; only labels are tracked open (+0.16em).

rules.name: The Corner Label Rule
rules.body: The 11px uppercase label names a place, group, card or datum (card names, FAQ group titles, footer column heads, photo captions, address, schedule phase, step counter "01 — 04"). It sits at the corner of the thing it names, in Tinta 60 (Crema at 62–70% on dark bands).

rules.name: The Glass-Over-Light Rule
rules.body: Glass appears only where a layer floats over imagery or a halo: header pill, mobile bottom bar, hero card, FAQ card over its halo, and the cursor halo. Content cards are opaque.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is tinted Tinta or orange. No grey or black shadows, no hard offsets.

rules.name: The Sun-Shape Rule
rules.body: New geometry comes from the circle, the arch and the pill. No sharp-cornered rectangles, no diagonal cuts.

dos: **Do** take every visual value from the SUNNA Web reference canvas and every word from the brief.
**Do** use the 11px uppercase +0.16em label to name the card, group, place or datum it sits on.
**Do** mark missing content with the 11px monospace `[PENDIENTE]` marker instead of inventing it.
**Do** keep all headlines at weight 400 with tightening tracking.
**Do** fuse the CTA pill with its oversized arrow disc; it is the one action shape.
**Do** use 28px corners on cards, 14/16px inside them, 999px on pills and 180px on arch photos.
**Do** keep the film grain and warm-tinted shadows on every surface.
**Do** respect reduced motion (halos stop breathing, scroll animations off) and reduced transparency (glass turns solid Naranja 50).
donts: **Don't** add dark surfaces beyond the Recovery band, the founders band, the footer and the Premium card.
**Don't** put glass on content cards; glass is only for layers floating over light or imagery.
**Don't** use bold weights or pictorial icon sets; glyphs are geometric outlines.
**Don't** use grey or black shadows or hard offset shadows.
**Don't** introduce colors outside the orange ramp, cream, tostado and Tinta.
